heroHeadline: Day 370: BRICS FM Summit Closes Without Communique as Iran War Splits Bloc — Pakistan Tests Fatah-4 as Ceasefire Holds
heroSubtitle: May 15, 2026: The BRICS Foreign Ministers' Summit in New Delhi concluded without a joint communique — the first failure of bloc consensus in recent history — as deep divisions over the Iran-UAE-US war proved irreconcilable; India released a Chair's Summary in lieu of a joint statement. EAM Jaishankar called for urgent global governance reform; PM Modi met individual BRICS ministers on the sidelines. No India-Pakistan bilateral meeting occurred at the summit: India's precondition (Pakistan dismantle cross-border terrorist infrastructure) remains unmet. Pakistan's ISPR announced a successful training launch of the Fatah-4 ground-launched cruise missile around May 13–15, continuing post-Sindoor military readiness signaling. The ceasefire brokered on May 10, 2025 reached Day 370 on May 15 with no new Line of Control incidents. The bilateral freeze remains total: mutual airspace closure through May 24, Indus Waters Treaty suspended, no ambassadors exchanged, all trade halted.
footerNote: Data sourced from Indian MEA/MOD, Pakistan ISPR/MFA, UN Security Council, SIPRI, Crisis Group, HRW, Stimson Center
